rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun phrase for obedience to a person, authority, rule, or order.

example.english: My obedience to the teacher doesn't mean I have no opinions of my own.
example.traditional: 我對老師嘅服從，唔代表我冇自己諗法。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 lou5 si1 ge3 fuk6 cung4 m4 doi6 biu2 ngo5 mou5 zi6 gei2 nam2 faat3
